title: File exceeds 1000 lines (14026 lines)
detail: File is 14026 lines, well above the 1000-line maintainability threshold. Large files typically contain many unrelated concerns and make code review and change-isolation harder. Suggested fix: split into smaller modules by responsibility.

title: Broad exception caught (bare `except Exception`) at 32 sites (L651,L1139,L1190,L1916,L2015,L2227)
detail: Multiple `except Exception` handlers use `excutils.save_and_reraise_exception()`, which is acceptable OpenStack idiom. A few handlers only log without re-raising. Suggested fix: review non-reraise handlers and narrow the exception type where the specific exceptions from the callee are known.

title: Inconsistent return statements: 14 functions mix explicit/implicit returns (L2394,L4171,L6320,L6506,L7062,L7083)
detail: Some functions return a value on some paths and fall off the end (returning `None` implicitly) on others. Callers that rely on the return value may receive `None` unexpectedly. Suggested fix: add an explicit `return` on all branches or refactor to raise on error paths.

title: Exception context suppressed: 15 `raise` statements without `from` (L625,L1323,L1331,L2215,L3136,L3196)
detail: Raising a new exception inside an `except` block without `raise NewExc() from exc` discards the original traceback, making debugging harder. Suggested fix: use `raise NewExc() from exc` or `raise NewExc() from None` if suppression is intentional.

title: Unpacked output variable(s) silently discarded: guest_cpu_numa, err, cpu_set at L10994,12731,13304
detail: Function returns a tuple; one or more unpacked variables are never read. If the discarded variable carries error information (e.g. stderr from a subprocess call), silent discard means errors go unlogged. Suggested fix: check or log the discarded value, or use `_` if intentional.

title: Variable `thing` possibly used before assignment at L12713
detail: Variable `thing` is assigned in `if isinstance(e, ...)` and `elif isinstance(...)` branches inside an except block. If `e` matches neither type (impossible by construction of the except clause, but not verifiable statically), `thing` would be unassigned at L12713. Add an `else: thing = repr(e)` to guard the use. Suggested fix: add `else: thing = str(e)` fallback.

title: Silent exception swallow during live-migration cleanup (L12747)
detail: At L12747, `self._remotefs.remove_dir(dest, inst_base)` is wrapped in `except Exception: pass`, silently dropping any failure during post-live-migration cleanup. If directory removal fails, the caller gets no indication and stale directories may persist. Suggested fix: replace `pass` with `LOG.warning(...)` at minimum.

title: Unpacked `cpu_set` and `guest_cpu_numa` from _get_guest_numa_config() never used (L10994)
detail: At L10994, `cpu_set, guest_cpu_tune, guest_cpu_numa, guest_numa_tune = self._get_guest_numa_config(...)` unpacks 4 values but `cpu_set` and `guest_cpu_numa` are never referenced in the function body. The NUMA config returns all four; dropping two of them may indicate incomplete migration logic. Suggested fix: verify these are deliberately unused and replace with `_`.
